description: This file is a test class for the BookController in the book project. It contains unit tests for the BookController's endpoints, verifying behaviors such as retrieving all books, finding books by ID, updating books, and deleting books. The tests use Mockito for mocking dependencies and JUnit 5 for the testing framework.

classes.name: BookControllerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for BookController, testing various API endpoints and behaviors.

methods.name: all_pageNumberIsOptional
methods.description: Test that calling 'all' without a page number defaults to calling the service with null.

methods.name: all_returnsEmptyList_whenNoBooksExist
methods.description: Test that the controller returns an empty list when no books are present.

methods.name: all_returnsBadRequest_whenNegativePage
methods.description: Test that a negative page number results in a BAD_REQUEST exception.

methods.name: all_returnsNonEmptyList_whenBooksExist
methods.description: Test that the controller returns a list of books when books exist.

methods.name: findById_returnsBook_ifPresent
methods.description: Test that finding by ID returns the book if it exists.

methods.name: findById_returnsNotFound_ifBookIsEmpty
methods.description: Test that searching for a non-existent book ID throws a ResponseStatusException.

methods.name: findByShelf_returnsNotFound_ifBookDoesNotExist
methods.description: Placeholder for test verifying behavior when books are not found by shelf; currently not implemented.

methods.name: update_callsService_ifBookPresent
methods.description: Test that updating a book calls the service with correct parameters if the book exists.

methods.name: update_throwsNotFoundException_ifBookNotPresent
methods.description: Test that updating a non-existent book throws a ResponseStatusException.

methods.name: getGenres_alwaysReturnsNonEmptyArray
methods.description: Test that getGenres always returns a non-empty array.

methods.name: delete_returnsNotFound_ifBookDoesNotExist
methods.description: Test that deleting a non-existent book returns a 404 response.

methods.name: delete_returnsOk_ifBookExists
methods.description: Test that deleting an existing book returns a 200 OK response.
